# wallix-bastion_local_password_policy (Data Source)

Provides information about a local password policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Without password_policy_name, the policy named "default"
data "wallix-bastion_local_password_policy" "default" {}

# Generate a password with the minimums of the policy
resource "random_password" "jdoe" {
  length      = max(data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_min_length, 16)
  min_upper   = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_min_upper_chars
  min_lower   = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_min_lower_chars
  min_numeric = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_min_digit_chars
  min_special = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_min_special_chars
}

resource "wallix-bastion_user" "jdoe" {
  user_name  = "jdoe"
  email      = "jdoe@example.com"
  profile    = "user"
  user_auths = ["local_password"]
  password   = random_password.jdoe.result
}

output "default_password_policy" {
  value = {
    min_length         = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_min_length
    expiration_days    = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.password_expiration
    max_auth_failures  = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.max_auth_failures
    ssh_key_algorithms = data.wallix-bastion_local_password_policy.default.ssh_key_algos_allowed
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `password_policy_name` (String)

### Read-Only

- `allow_same_user_and_password` (Boolean)
- `forbidden_passwords` (Set of String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_passwords_to_reject` (Number)
- `max_auth_failures` (Number)
- `password_expiration` (Number)
- `password_min_digit_chars` (Number)
- `password_min_length` (Number)
- `password_min_lower_chars` (Number)
- `password_min_special_chars` (Number)
- `password_min_upper_chars` (Number)
- `password_warning_days` (Number)
- `ssh_key_algos_allowed` (Set of String)
- `ssh_rsa_min_length` (Number)

## Usage Notes

The policy is looked up by `password_policy_name`, `default` when it isn't set; the data source
fails when no policy has this name.

From the API documentation:

- `password_expiration` is the number of days before a password expires (`0`: never), and
  `password_warning_days` the number of days the user is warned before (`0`: no warning);
- `max_auth_failures` is the number of authentication failures allowed per user (`0`: no limit);
- `last_passwords_to_reject` is the number of last used passwords that are rejected;
- `ssh_rsa_min_length` is the minimum length of an RSA key, in bits, and
  `ssh_key_algos_allowed` the SSH key algorithms allowed.
